questions.prompt: Congo Free State, Leopold II's rubber regime
questions.note: The famous 10M is a population-decline estimate, repeated as a death count. Serious scholarship spans an order of magnitude.
The ceiling is the most-repeated figure — it is the official PRC number. The scholarly low end is five to seven times smaller.
Here even the low estimate is the largest famine in recorded history. The spread is about method, not about whether it was a catastrophe.
The high figures come from Spanish chroniclers — the people who conquered and converted them, with every motive to exaggerate. Source-laundering in pure form.
French official counts sat near 11,000; the 89,000 high end became the figure that travels. Both endpoints are still quoted as if certain.
